description:
E2M1 Q/KV + E4M3 group16；shared K=V D512 → BF16. Prepared Q/KV/scales/index metadata -> QK -> softmax -> PV -> native outputs; excludes projection/RoPE/cache writer. Dense MQA D512/shared K=V；page64；decode/MTP Q1/3/6/16，H16/32/64/128；上下文63..65537；sink、可选ln-LSE；B*Q*H>=128；SM100/103。不是 sparse C2/C3，也不是 absorbed D576。 Caller workspace is mutable scratch; its contents are not mathematical scoring outputs. The standard evaluator checks the declared writable regions.

Production entry: flashinfer.mla.prepare_nvfp4_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla; fixed source revision d849eca46875d3561fa48f6093936304580a1698.

Parameter domain: shape_range.json defines dynamic request ranges and correlated model/ABI constraints; shape_cases.json fixes 10 representative workloads, not the complete support domain. Decode/MTP Q=1..16 with dynamic per-request KV through 262144; latent dimension512 and packed KV page64 remain fixed. No measured traffic weights are claimed. Existing GPU evidence covers only the unchanged fixed sample, not every point in this dynamic domain.

Input construction: Retain prepared production payload/scale, strides, page tables, aliases and QDQ. Q/K/V now share a synthetic latent family: four topics, eight fixed sinusoidal projection components, independent token innovations, per-head gains .65..1.35 and channel gains .7..1.3. Q and K topic affinity creates nonuniform attention, and K/V share latent topic features. In absorbed MLA, V remains the actual first 512 components of stored K; D576 keeps a separate 64-channel RoPE-amplitude component, while the distinct D512 interface stays D512. No hidden unquantized truth enters the reference. Existing tiny/peaked/zero/cancellation and scale controls are preserved after construction. These are declared synthetic projection statistics, not observed model weights or traffic.

Numerical contract reference-materialization-v1-20261013: NVFP4 MLA with independent FP32 computation and explicit quantization.

V: decoded E2M1 * E4M3 -> FP16 -> saturating RNE E4M3.
P: 128-key groups, log2 maximum delayed until it increases by >2,
64 * exp(score - normalizer) -> saturating RNE E4M3 for PV.
Denominator/LSE use unrounded P; a sink seeds only the first split.
Prepared split partials are BF16 before an independent FP32 LSE merge. Independent FP32 between stated QDQ/storage boundaries, TF32 disabled. No native approximate exp/reciprocal instructions define reference truth. Prior reference and contract: evidence/reference-revision-20261013/before.tar.gz. Source basis: docs/production-bench-v3/CORE_NUMERICAL_ATTRIBUTION_20261013.md.

limitations: No deployment-specific frequency or device-time weight is claimed.

real_inputs.reason: General source-derived shapes and stored-precision synthetic payloads; real traffic is not part of this core contract.
